StateShard.title: StateShard
StateShard.description: Fragmented cloud storage shard for EvaluaPlus centralized state (meta, config, students, questions, attempts, liveSessions, abpro, customMiniRetos, snapshots).

shardType.description: Category of the shard (meta, config, students, questions, attempts, extras, snapshot).

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON chunk (<800KB per shard to respect 1MB Firestore document limit).

chunkCount.description: Total number of chunks for this entity type.
